integrity: Analytic proof for all n >=3 and exact-arithmetic corroboration; priority historically provisional; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional results are proved for unit-weight cyclic edge-diamond Minkowski sums in the given Euclidean embedding; general hypergraph reductions are exact but need not have closed numerical evaluation. The main 2026 source already entails the general inradius subset inequality and no historical originality is claimed for that deduction.
title: Exact Euclidean ellipsoids and parity contact counts for cyclic edge-diamond sums
